article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New? (Community Event: Sanctuary Trick or Treat Party)
article_summaries.summary: An official SOE news post announcing a community Trick or Treat party in Sanctuary during the 2010 Super Spooktacular Halloween event. The Community Team and friends were to attend in costume with Chiller Boomboxes, and the daily Trick or Treat quests were offered there. The article gives two dated server 1 sessions, one for the US and Latin America and one for the UK and Europe.

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New? (Community Event: Costume Parade)
article_summaries.summary: A community event announcement for a Costume Parade on Friday October 23rd, 2009, run on Server 1 at two times for US/Latin America and UK/Europe. Players were to bring their pet, wear a costume, teleport to Blackspore, party about an hour, then march out of the swamp into Crossroads. The post date is not printed; the page's relative timestamp ('1 week, 20 hours ago' at capture on 2009-10-30) suggests about October 21, 2009.
